stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks in Geneva
stories.summary: Dramatic escalation: Iran fired live missiles toward Hormuz and Khamenei threatened to sink the US warship in the Gulf, all during round 2 of Geneva talks. Military brinksmanship now dominates alongside diplomacy. Graham warned 'intervention within weeks.' Highest-stakes story of the week.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
